V1R4 Microsoft

Windows

Server 2025

STIG, V1R3

- WN25-00-000020, WN25-AC-000050 -

Updated max password age value to 180 days.

- WN25-00-000140 - Revised default

permissions in Check text.

- WN25-00-000190 - Replaced CCI number.

- WN25-00-000480 - Added requirement that

OS must be maintained at supported

servicing level.

- WN25-CC-000530 - Added log storage

location guidance.

- WN25-DC-000320 - Revised Check text

due to OS change.

- WN25-MS-000140 - Added NA statement

for Microsoft Exchange Server. Updated max

password age value to 180 days.

- WN25-SO-000140 - Removed rule due to

overlap with WN25-SO-000130.

- WN25-UC-000010 - Revised Check text to

address all interactive user profiles.

- Requirements were updated throughout to

reflect the change from DOD to DoW.

- Rule numbers updated throughout due to

changes in content management system.

30 September 2026

V1R3 Microsoft

Windows

Server 2025

STIG, V1R2

- WN25-00-000332 - Corrected syntax in

Check text PS command.

- WN25-DC-000405 - Removed requirement

due to removal of setting in Windows Server

OS.

- WN25-PK-000020, WN25-PK-000030 -

Revised to remove validation of Thumbprint

and expiration dates.

- WN25-SH-000080 - Corrected permission

values in Check and Fix.

- WN25-PK-000010 - Minor edits to Check

and Fix text.

- WN25-SH-000030, WN25-DC-000430 -

Addressed issues of STIG style compliance.

- Requirements were updated throughout to

reflect the change from DOD to DoW.

10 August 2026

STIG, V1R1

- WN25-00-000030 - Revised Discussion,

Check, and Fix to clarify description of

prohibited access to external systems.

- WN25-00-000090 - Revised Title. Removed

NA statement from Check. Removed

reference to TPM 1.2 in Check and Fix.

- WN25-00-000170 - Revised Check and Fix

to reflect default account differences in

Domain Controllers and Member Servers.

- WN25-00-000240 - Revised Check and Fix

to add .pfx files and remove Adobe files.

- WN25-00-000250 - Revised Check and Fix

to provide a Not Applicable rationale.

- WN25-AU-000060 - Revised Check to

include NA statement for Core Edition.

- WN25-AU-000581, WN25-AU-000582,

WN25-AU-000584 - Removed requirement

due to operational issues.

- WN25-CC-000280 - Revised Rule Title,

Discussion, Check, and Fix.

- WN25-DC-000190, WN25-DC-000210 -

Added optional step at end of Check and Fix.

- WN25-DC-000310 - Removed CCI-000776

from References.

- WN25-PK-000010 - Revised Check and Fix

to remove CA 4 Cert from list of required

DOD Root CA certificates.
